[P2] Preserve service outcomes when evidence publication fails

If checkpointing succeeds but the subsequent S3 publication raises, this wrapper discards the successful response. The SDK marks the batch failed without consuming the returned checkpoint token, turning an evidence-storage failure into an artificial SDK failure. Publications in `finally` can also replace backend exceptions or return values, including in `get_execution_state`. Isolate evidence-publication failures from backend outcomes, report them separately as collection errors, and cover a successful backend call with a failing evidence sink.
